I also noted that wiring this view into the actual access-check flow belongs to the not-yet-built `ContractDetailPage` task, and flagged the inferred back-link/visual choices.

Output written to `.ui-gen/outputs/T-ACCESS-DENIED-VIEW-UI.json`.
